reviews.text: I visit Patong three times a year and stay right across the street at Café Lavazza. I drink my cappuccino every day at the cannabis shop. I really enjoy it there and would like to sincerely thank the lovely lady who serves me daily. ✌️🇹🇭😎
J y ai acheter 4g de hash pour l équivalent de 30e.... rien a voir avec ce qui se fais un europe c est de la qualite supérieur mais je n ai pas goûter l herbe
reviews.text_en: I bought 4g of hash there for the equivalent of €30... it's nothing like what you get in Europe, it's superior quality, but I didn't taste the herb.

reviews.text: A good place! Maurizio a very good person!!!

Great service, very chill atmosphere
Price is very good, would definitely recommend this place!
I've spent a long time in patong. Definitely the best smoke i have found here. 100% recommend here. Owner and staff are very friendly

Absolutely, unequivocally the best dispensary in all of Phuket. I would say products here can rival most dispensaries in the world. The service is top notch and the the food is amazing if you want something different or here Thai food. The Cheif is actually Italian and the pizza is green light just like being back in Napoli if you want the best then there is no other place been to Bangkok, Pattaya, Chiang Mai and Phuket this is the best to date! Cheers!
Best place in town! Very good prices for what you get! In my opinion the best shop from the whole patong area! A lot of good discounts!
Bellissima esperienza coffee shop bellissimo staff gentile ed educato caffè buonissimo italiano 100% qualità di erba super!!!!💯💯💯
reviews.text_en: Beautiful coffee shop experience, beautiful, kind and polite staff, excellent Italian coffee, 100% super quality grass!!!!💯💯💯

Vielle weed , jamais renouvelé. Qualité médiocre . Mais le personnel est très gentil.
reviews.text_en: Old weed, never replenished. Poor quality. But the staff are very friendly.

reviews.text: Punto di riferimento a Patong se non vuoi essere rapinato ,prezzi onesti e ottima fornitura ☺️  il mio preferito resta il Mint hashish
reviews.text_en: A point of reference in Patong if you don't want to be robbed, honest prices and excellent supply ☺️ my favorite remains the Mint hashish

reviews.text_en: The owner is really cool, I came in February 2023, I hope he's still open, his Instagram page has been deleted

reviews.text: phenomenal weed and owner is so sweet!

Трава и гашиш норм, но уже вторую неделю нет фильтров, хотя персонал говорит, что заказали. Грамм гашиша 450, но если вы берете пол грамма, то цена 250. Акция 3 грамма любой травы за 1000 бат, но тем не менее не вся трава попадает под эту акцию…
reviews.text_en: The weed and hash are fine, but for two weeks now, there haven't been any filters, even though the staff says we ordered them. A gram of hashish costs 450 baht, but if you order half a gram, the price is 250 baht. There's a special offer of 3 grams of any weed for 1,000 baht, but not all weed is eligible for this deal…

reviews.text: The best coffee shop for a Latte and a smoke by a long shot.  I couldn't find a nice coffee in alot of the other "coffee"shops in Patong.
